_comment: Storyboard map for meta-create-skill VIDEO 7: Review + Harden (CP4 'Make it reliable', first explainer). Rebuilt 2026-09-23 on the locked running example (DESIGN-SYSTEM §9): the skill being hardened is draft-email/, which writes drafts/weekly-email.md from stats/last-week.csv; the fabricated line is '34% · our best month yet'. 5 diagrams in teaching order, one column each. Arc: Pain (a draft that is quietly wrong beats a run that breaks) -> Cause (your rules ARE in the file under ## Conventions, from the interview and your correction, but ## Self-check before handing it over is empty, so nothing checks the draft) -> Mechanism (the same file with that section filled: the AI checks the draft against every rule before it hands anything over = hardening) -> Proof (the self-check stops the 34% draft) -> Durability (the scorecard: 5 tests the AI re-runs itself after every edit; test 5 stopped Tuesday's edit). THE DECK'S ONE JOB: every slide is about A STATED RULE the skill can check itself against. What the skill cannot know about itself belongs in v8-harness. Slides 02 and 03 share one geometry so they read as a before/after swipe.

columns.label: 1 - THE LOUD FAILURE WAS NEVER THE PROBLEM
2 - YOUR RULES ARE IN THE FILE. NOTHING CHECKS THE DRAFT.
3 - HARDENING = A CHECK BEFORE IT HANDS YOU ANYTHING
4 - THE SELF-CHECK STOPS THE 34% BEFORE YOU SEE IT
5 - AFTER EVERY EDIT, RE-RUN THESE 5 TESTS
